title: GeneratedProjectChallenge
description: Schema enforcing deterministic structured outputs for dynamically generated technical challenges.

title.description: Short, realistic engineering challenge title (e.g. 'Build a Filterable Activity Feed')

description.description: Comprehensive markdown instructions including user stories, constraints, acceptance criteria, and guidance.

technologies.description: Strict subset of the requested technologies (must not contain unselected tech).

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Accurate, realistic time budget for completing the exercise.

starterFiles.description: Starter repository files presented to candidate in the workspace.

content.description: Initial starter boilerplate code with clear TODO comments

readOnly.description: True for configuration files (tsconfig, package.json), false for implementation files

publicTests.description: Automated tests visible to the user during the practice session.

content.description: Vitest or Jest test suite verifying the primary happy-path contracts

privateTests.description: Private automated tests strictly withheld until final evaluation.

content.description: Comprehensive tests verifying edge cases, error conditions, and boundary behavior

canonicalSolution.description: Working reference solution files used by the platform to pre-validate the exercise before user presentation.

path.description: Relative file path matching corresponding starter file

content.description: Fully working implementation code passing 100% of public and private tests
